question: Of the two alfalfa silage groups, how many silos were in the group with the lower pH, and what acetic acid concentration did that group have?
rendered:
Document: Fermentation Quality Divergence of Alfalfa Silage within the Same Batch: Insights from 16S rRNA Sequencing and Untargeted Metabolomics, page 3

According to the text, the group with the lower pH was the LPGood group, which had 49 silos. The acetic acid concentration in the LPGood group was significantly higher, with a value of 9.18 ± 0.46% DM.
